name: Deal Router
description: Routes high-fit contact-venture pairs to deal execution. Generates scripts, assigns to you or agents, creates ClickUp tasks.

config.script: return {contact_id: data.contact_id, venture_id: data.venture_id, fit_score: data.fit_score, warmth_score: data.warmth_score};

body.prompt: Generate a 3-sentence cold outreach script for {{contact_data[0].name}} ({{contact_data[0].sector}} background) about {{venture_data[0].name}} ({{venture_data[0].description}}). Make it personalized, specific to their sector expertise, mention 1 key pain point the venture solves. Format: {script: string, hook: string, cta: string}

steps.name: Determine assignment (warmth > 80 → you, else → sector agent)

config.script: const assigned_to = deal_pair.warmth_score > 80 ? 'you' : 'sector_agent_' + contact_data[0].sector; return {assigned_to, warmth_threshold_met: deal_pair.warmth_score > 80};

steps.name: Create ClickUp task for human review (if warmth > 80)

body.name: Warm Intro: {{contact_data[0].name}} → {{venture_data[0].name}}

config.subject: Deal Route: {{contact_data[0].name}} → {{venture_data[0].name}} ({{(deal_pair.fit_score * 100) | round}}% fit)
